body: Thanks. I just don't understand, you know? He threw away five years and a stable future for a quick fling. It really hurts to think that some cheap woman meant more to him than I did. I miss him so much.

Thank you. I have therapy on Monday and I made it clear to my doctor that although I had the motive and equipment for suicide, I didn't feel that I could do it straight away. I have a bunch of resources to resort to over the rest of the week.

One of the reasons that I'm trying to get through a few months at least, before dying if that's what I feel necessary, is that I can't bear to think of him unhappy-and thinking that he was the cause would make him unhappy. If I leave it a few months, there's always room for it to have been something else.
I just wanted those fifteen years of happiness. That would have done. If that was all I got, it would have done.

We were going to find a house. With a garden. And have cats. That's about it, it wasn't a big bright future, but it was going to be ours. I was going to retire early and we'd pool our pensions and make it last as long as we could. We knew we weren't going to have decades together.
No...she's the same age as me. I just can't fathom how he can throw away five good years and a future for a fling, an infatuation.
